description: The bank and card lines in the books that took money out and have no receipt yet (missing), each with the receipt waiting in Expenses to sort that fits it on amount, date and shop when there is one (suggestions, receipts), and the matches a shop the user confirmed before made by itself (toReview). Amounts are signed like a statement: money out is negative. planRequired=true means the books are on the Free plan, where matching is not offered. This only reads: the user matches a receipt, marks a line as needing none, or keeps or undoes a match in Mobile Accounting.
